svg.title: Scoring analysis records outside the cluster
svg.desc: Overview of ADR-0047. The analyzer of the www cluster, which we do not run, creates a record in its records container. Blob created goes through an Event Grid system topic to a storage queue. A Container Apps job that scales to zero takes one message per execution. It checks the size and the schema, runs the redactor again and quarantines the record on any hit before any model call, ends without a model call when the record is already scored or the month's cap is reached, then makes one judge call from the other model family than the analysis, with allowlisted fields, a fixed prompt, a fixed answer schema and one tool, a cross-check by a second model asked at most once. It creates the score and deletes the message. Two separate model keys, each capped at 40 to 50 USD a month in its provider's console and in code. Scores and quarantined records are in their own containers with a retention period. One managed identity reads records, reads and writes scores, writes quarantine, processes one queue and reads two Key Vault secrets. It has no storage key and no cluster credential.
svg.text: not run by us; creates a record
sends the event to the queue
at least once; a message is deleted
only after the score is written
CONTAINER APPS JOB, SCALES TO ZERO, ONE MESSAGE PER EXECUTION, NO INGRESS
1 Blob properties: over 1 MiB, quarantine note, content not downloaded
2 Schema: known fields and version only; otherwise quarantine
3 Redactor Clean on every string and key; any hit quarantines the record
4 Already scored (record ID and hash) or the month's cap reached: no model call
5 One judge call: allowlisted fields, fixed prompt and answer schema, one tool
(cross_check, at most once, counted in code). Token limits per call and per run.
6 Create the score (create-only), then delete the message. A failed read is retried.
After the dequeue bound: a score with status error.
each capped 40 to 50 USD a month
in the console and in code
read the records container; read and write scores; write quarantine; process messages of the one queue;
read the value of two Key Vault secrets (the two intake keys), each at its own scope.
a storage key, a write or delete on records, a cluster or Git credential, a role assignment right, any use of a score to decide an action.
